notes: live/surfaces.test.ts keeps the ten org /api/v1/passkeys routes deny-only (#2263): every handler answers only a browser session (routes/passkeys.ts member() calls interactiveSession), and the suite's sessions are hook-minted, so an allowed caller is never answered live. DROPPED (interactive-only), INTERACTIVE_ONLY and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record them; the in-server matrix and apps/server/test/passkeys.test.ts cover the allowed legs. The pick answer and its challenge (artifact comments answer, answer challenge) are artifact routes an agent token can also reach, so they stay ordinary cases.

live/surfaces.test.ts drops GET /api/v1/usage (org GET /api/v1/usage) while every hosted install sets FEATURES usage_off; DROPPED and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record it (P5 plan Task 3b, #655).

live/surfaces.test.ts drops POST /api/v1/admin/broker-check (org POST /api/v1/admin/broker-check): owner-only, and no owner credential is stored in CI, so it has no live success leg. DROPPED and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record it; apps/server/test/redline.foreign-credential.test.ts proves another install's owner session and PAT are refused (#730).

live/surfaces.test.ts runs A's credential at B live only for one smoke per credential kind (SMOKES in src/surfaces.ts: session, PAT, OAuth) and the eleven deny-only cases; every other case's A at B is the in-server matrix's foreign callers (MATRIX_AT_B), which coverageGaps checks (#1137 group B).

live/surfaces.test.ts keeps org POST /api/v1/members/:id/erase deny-only: the route answers only an interactive sign-in and the suite's sessions are hook-minted (provider test), which it hides with a 404 like a PAT. DROPPED (interactive-only) and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record it; the in-server matrix erases a real removed, artifact-less person as the admin (#1204).

live/surfaces.test.ts keeps org PUT /api/v1/bus/roles and org DELETE /api/v1/bus/roles/:id deny-only for the same reason (#1296): role writes take only an interactive sign-in (through bus/routes.ts roleWriter), so no AI agent can set or claim a role. DROPPED (interactive-only), INTERACTIVE_ONLY and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record them; the in-server matrix writes each allowed caller's own roles in an Access session, and apps/server/test/bus/roles.rest.test.ts proves a cookie session writes and a PAT is refused.

live/surfaces.test.ts keeps org PUT /api/v1/bus/links and org DELETE /api/v1/bus/links/:id deny-only for the same reason (#1567): link writes take only an interactive sign-in (through bus/routes.ts roleWriter), so no AI agent can widen what a namespace reaches. DROPPED (interactive-only), INTERACTIVE_ONLY and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record them; the in-server matrix writes each allowed caller's own links in an Access session, and apps/server/test/bus/links.rest.test.ts proves a cookie session writes and a PAT is refused.

live/surfaces.test.ts keeps org PUT /api/v1/bus/reach and org DELETE /api/v1/bus/reach/:id deny-only for the same reason (#1346): reach writes take only an interactive sign-in (through bus/routes.ts roleWriter), so no AI agent can widen what a role reaches. DROPPED (interactive-only), INTERACTIVE_ONLY and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record them; the in-server matrix writes each allowed caller's own reach in an Access session, apps/server/test/bus/reach.rest.test.ts proves a cookie session writes and a PAT is refused, and apps/server/test/bus/bus.billing-gate.test.ts proves a plan-capped member is refused a new grant (PUT) but may still remove one (DELETE).

live/surfaces.test.ts keeps org PUT /api/v1/bus/share-notices deny-only for the same reason: the route takes only an interactive sign-in (through share-notices.ts browserUser), so B's hook-minted session gets a 404. DROPPED (interactive-only), INTERACTIVE_ONLY and EXCLUDED_ROUTES in src/surfaces.ts record it; the in-server matrix saves each allowed caller's own list in an Access session, and apps/server/test/follows.test.ts proves a cookie session saves and a PAT is refused (#1313). test/surfaces.test.ts now finds interactive-only routes through helpers and in every file under apps/server/src.

#1235: live/surfaces.test.ts runs A's credential at A only on the session and PAT smokes (SMOKES), as the positive control for their A-at-B leg; every other case runs B's own credential at B, and A_AT_A in src/surfaces.ts names what replaces its A at A. The 17 live cases retired in #1235 are listed with the failure each guarded and their replacements in src/retired.ts, which the fake suite holds to this manifest.

live/provisioning.test.ts no longer runs P35 (a routeless Worker fetches rl-a /healthz): the runner can't stand in for that Worker, so it could only ever be unproven. The gap is #1260; REMOVED_PROBES in src/provisioning.ts records it.

live/provisioning.test.ts no longer runs P50 (the held-sweep snooze owner path on rl-snz): proved live once, and covered by apps/server/test/directory.snooze.test.ts and the authz surface list (apps/server/test/authz/surfaces.ts) (#1078); REMOVED_PROBES in src/provisioning.ts records it.
